MATCH (src:PlantItem)-[:line_to]->(dst:PlantItem)
WHERE dst.unit_id = '464'
  AND src.unit_id IS NOT NULL
  AND src.unit_id <> '464'
RETURN DISTINCT src.unit_id AS unit_id, src.tag AS tag
ORDER BY unit_id, tag;

MATCH (source:PlantItem)-[:line_to]->(target:PlantItem)
WHERE target.unit_id = '100'
  AND source.unit_id IS NOT NULL
  AND source.unit_id <> '100'
RETURN DISTINCT source.unit_id AS unit_id, source.tag AS tag
ORDER BY unit_id, tag;
